propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() spans 408 lines (59% of runner.py) and must be decomposed into smaller functions along semantic seams to reduce file and method size while staying under the 700-line headroom guard

A latent defect allows httpx.AsyncClient to leak when exceptions are raised in the 151-line pre-call window before the try guard at line 474, despite ProviderSession.__enter__/__exit__ existing but never being used

The extraction of interpret_failure, build_model_settings, build_usage_limits, and guarding the provider session with a context manager must each individually clear the 700 LOC headroom guard when stacked, not just cumulatively, because CI verifies per-patchset
Six monkeypatch.setattr targets in tests must be repointed when their definitions move modules, with each child commit owning the repoints for names it relocates and naming them in the commit message

The _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED mutation at runner.py:444-445 must remain inline in run() rather than move into build_model_settings to preserve the leaf invariant of structured_run.py (no runtime import of runner)
Comments and documentation anchors must be preserved across the split with no measured facts, file citations, bug IDs, failure modes, or invariants lost to satisfy the size gate
